remarks: Welcome to a home filled with the kind of character you simply don’t find in newer construction! From the full-length covered front porch to the original hardwood floors and beautiful natural woodwork, this spacious 4-bedroom home is packed with timeless details and plenty of room to make it your own. Inside, over sized windows fill the home with natural light while the expansive living and formal dining rooms provide an inviting setting for everyday living, holidays, and entertaining. A classic hardwood swinging door leads from the dining room into the kitchen, adding another touch of the home’s original charm. Upstairs, four spacious bedrooms offer hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and plenty of flexibility. But the possibilities don’t stop there! A walk-up attic provides an impressive amount of bonus space - perfect for creating additional living space, a home office, studio, recreation room, or simply enjoying the extra storage. The full basement offers even more storage and workshop space, along with a stand-in shower. Recent improvements include a brand-new furnace, 200-amp electrical panel, a brand new gas line, updated plumbing, and fresh paint. With its welcoming front porch, spacious rooms, original craftsmanship, and endless possibilities, this home is ready for someone to bring their vision to life. If you’ve been searching for a home with personality, space, and the opportunity to truly make it your own, this one deserves a closer look!
